title: Long straight through cut along +y at C = 0; the rear wheel follows the kerf
rationale: At C = 0 the rear support is 402 mm straight behind the tool (safety-model 4.2). Cutting 520 mm forward, the rear wheel disc reaches the start of the fresh kerf once the tool is 402 - (55 + 3.25) mm past it: the classic hazard of safety-model 7.3. The vendor never tested the footprint against removed material (spec 05).
